title: Lockfile lookups fail for keys containing '~1'
statement:
We address lockfile entries with buildkit.jsonpointer and build the pointers with escape(). Lookups fail for any package whose key contains a tilde range:

    >>> from buildkit.jsonpointer import escape, get
    >>> lock = {'deps': {'left-pad@~1.1': {'version': '1.1.3'}}}
    >>> get(lock, '/deps/' + escape('left-pad@~1.1') + '/version')
    buildkit.jsonpointer.JsonPointerError: no member 'left-pad@/.1'

escape() produces '/deps/left-pad@~01.1/version', which looks right to us. Keys containing '/' (like '@scope/pkg') work. The docstring says parse(to_pointer(keys)) == keys for every list of string keys. Please make parse(), get() and set() handle every key correctly per RFC 6901.
